name: City of Torrance
caveat: Torrance’s layer has known gaps: it has no H-DA1 district and shows Del Amo Fashion Center as R3, where city filings place it in the Hawthorne Boulevard Corridor Specific Plan. Results here are therefore never decided outright; confirm the zoning with the city.

rules.why: The city's layer lists more than one district for this area (for example R1(C5) or C2/R3); check the Official Land Use Plan map (§ 91.3.2) for the parcel's district.

rules.why: Professional offices offering medical and dental services are a permitted use (§ 91.38.1(c)); confirm that the project's office or parking component fits the district.
